questions.text: The Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer (1987) primarily targets the phase-out of which category of chemicals?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Treaty-Chemical Mapping. Montreal -> **Ozone** -> **CFCs/HCFCs/Halons** (Ozone Depleting Substances). Kyoto/Paris -> **GHGs** (CO2, CH4). Stockholm -> **POPs**. Minamata -> **Mercury**. Full Solution: The Montreal Protocol was designed specifically to protect the stratospheric ozone layer by phasing the production and consumption of Ozone Depleting Substances (ODS), chiefly Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), Halons, Carbon Tetrachloride, and Methyl Chloroform. It is widely regarded as the most successful international environmental treaty.

questions.text: The Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution of India on the recommendation of which committee?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Link 'Fundamental Duties' with '42nd Amendment' (Mini Constitution) and 'Swaran Singh Committee'. Verma Committee is for Fundamental Duties *implementation* (1999), not addition. Full Solution: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 added Part IVA (Article 51A) consisting of Fundamental Duties on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee. The Verma Committee (1999) was constituted later to suggest measures for making Fundamental Duties effective.

questions.text: 'Regur' soil, characterized by high clay content, high moisture retention, and the development of deep cracks during dry weather, is most ideally suited for the cultivation of which major crop?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Regur' is the local/technical name for Black Cotton Soil. The keyword 'Cotton' is embedded in the common identity of the soil. Eliminate Wheat (Alluvial soil), Rice (Alluvial/Deltaic), Tea (Laterite/Hill slopes). Full Solution: Regur (Black Soil) is formed from the weathering of Deccan Trap basalt. It is rich in lime, iron, magnesia, and alumina but deficient in phosphorus, nitrogen, and organic matter. Its high clay content (montmorillonite) causes swelling when wet and deep cracking when dry (self-ploughing), creating ideal aeration and moisture conditions for Cotton, a deep-rooted crop.

questions.text: Anamudi, the highest peak in the Western Ghats and South India (2,695 m), is situated in which specific hill range?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Name-Association Rule. 'Anamudi' derives from 'Anai' (Elephant) + 'Mudi' (Peak/Head), directly linking it to the **Anaimalai** (Elephant Hills) range. Doddabetta (2,637 m) is the highest of Nilgiris. Full Solution: Anamudi is located in the Anaimalai Hills (also known as Elephant Hills) on the border of Kerala and Tamil Nadu, within the Eravikulam National Park. It is the highest point in India outside the Himalaya-Karakoram mountain system.

questions.text: Who was the first woman President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate post-Independence figures (Indira Gandhi, Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit). Sarojini Naidu was President in 1925. Annie Besant presided over the 1917 Calcutta session, making her the first woman President. Full Solution: Annie Besant became the first woman President of the Indian National Congress in 1917 (Calcutta Session). Sarojini Naidu was the first *Indian* woman President (1925, Kanpur Session).

questions.text: Consider the following statements regarding the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) and Consumer Price Index (CPI) in India: 1. WPI covers the services sector while CPI covers only goods. 2. The base year for the current WPI series is 2011-12. 3. CPI assigns a higher weightage to food items compared to WPI. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate via Statement 1. WPI covers ONLY goods (Primary Articles, Fuel & Power, Manufactured Products); it EXCLUDES services. CPI covers Goods AND Services. Thus, Statement 1 is false. Eliminate Options A and D. Statement 2 is true (WPI base revised to 2011-12 in 2017). Statement 3 is true (CPI Combined Food & Beverages weight ~45.9%; WPI Food Articles weight ~15.3% + Food Products ~9.9% = ~25%). Correct: 2 and 3 only. Full Solution: WPI basket (2011-12 series) has three groups: Manufactured Products (64.2%), Primary Articles (22.6%), Fuel & Power (13.1%) — no services. CPI (Combined) base 2012=100 has Food & Beverages (45.86%), Pan/Tobacco (2.38%), Clothing (6.53%), Housing (10.07%), Fuel (6.84%), Misc (28.32%).

questions.text: Which Schedule of the Constitution of India contains provisions relating to the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes in states other than Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram?
questions.solution: **Shortcut (Mnemonic):** **'5th for States (General), 6th for Special (NE)'**. The Fifth Schedule applies to Scheduled Areas/STs in mainland states (Art 244(1)). The Sixth Schedule applies only to Tribal Areas in the four NE states (Art 244(2)). The 7th Schedule contains the Three Lists (Union/State/Concurrent). The 9th Schedule protects land reform laws from judicial review. **Step-by-step:** 1. Identify the subject: Administration of Scheduled Areas & STs. 2. Recall Article 244. Clause (1) invokes Fifth Schedule for states *excluding* Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram. Clause (2) invokes Sixth Schedule for those four states. 3. Eliminate 7th Schedule (Distribution of Powers) and 9th Schedule (Validation of Acts). 4. Select Fifth Schedule.

questions.text: The Lucknow Session of the Indian National Congress held in 1916 is historically significant primarily for which of the following outcomes?

options.label: C
options.text: Signing of the Lucknow Pact between Congress and Muslim League

options.label: D
options.text: Adoption of the resolution for Purna Swaraj

questions.solution: Shortcut: Map key Congress Sessions to Year/Event: 1907 Surat = Split; 1916 Lucknow = Pact (Congress-League Unity) + Readmission of Extremists; 1920 Calcutta/Nagpur = Non-Cooperation; 1929 Lahore = Purna Swaraj. Eliminate options matching other years. Full Solution: The 1916 Lucknow Session (President: Ambika Charan Majumdar) witnessed two major developments: the reunion of the Moderates and Extremists (Tilak's group) and the signing of the Lucknow Pact between the INC and the All-India Muslim League, presenting a joint scheme of constitutional reforms.

questions.text: Which was the first Biosphere Reserve established in India under the UNESCO Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Chronological elimination. Nilgiri (1986) was the first. Nanda Devi (1988), Sundarbans (1989), Gulf of Mannar (1989) followed. Full Solution: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, spanning Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka, was the first biosphere reserve in India to be designated by UNESCO under the MAB programme in September 1986.

questions.text: Match the following Indian missiles with their correct type/classification: Missile Type 1. Agni A. Surface-to-Air (Short/Medium Range) 2. Prithvi B. Surface-to-Surface (Strategic / ICBM) 3. Akash C. Surface-to-Surface (Tactical / Short Range) 4. Nag D. Anti-Tank Guided Missile (Fire & Forget) Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use Name-Function Association. 'Agni' (Fire) -> Strategic Ballistic Missiles (Long Range/ICBM) -> Match B. 'Prithvi' (Earth) -> Tactical Battlefield Support (Short Range) -> Match C. 'Akash' (Sky) -> Air Defence / Surface-to-Air -> Match A. 'Nag' (Cobra) -> Anti-Tank (Ground hugging) -> Match D. Only Option A satisfies all four mappings. Full Solution: Agni series (I-V) are nuclear-capable Strategic Ballistic Missiles (SRBM to ICBM). Prithvi (I/II/III) are tactical Short-Range Ballistic Missiles (SRBM) for battlefield use. Akash is a Medium-Range Surface-to-Air Missile (SAM) system. Nag is a 3rd generation 'Fire-and-Forget' Anti-Tank Guided Missile (ATGM) with imaging infrared seeker.

questions.text: Under Article 356 of the Constitution of India, a Proclamation of President's Rule issued by the President must be approved by both Houses of Parliament within what period?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Memorize the standard constitutional approval periods: National Emergency (Art 352) = 1 month; President's Rule (Art 356) = 2 months; Ordinance (Art 123/213) = 6 weeks. Eliminate 1 month (Emergency) and 6 months (maximum initial duration without further extension). Full Solution: Article 356(3) stipulates that a Proclamation under Article 356(1) shall cease to operate at the expiration of two months unless before the expiration of that period it has been approved by resolutions of both Houses of Parliament.

questions.text: The resolution for 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) was formally adopted by the Indian National Congress at its annual session held in December 1929. Where was this session held?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Chronological elimination. 1906 Calcutta (Swadeshi), 1929 Lahore (Purna Swaraj -> triggers 1930 Civil Disobedience), 1931 Karachi (Endorses Gandhi-Irwin Pact), 1939 Tripuri (Bose vs Gandhi). Full Solution: The Lahore Session of December 1929, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru, declared 'Purna Swaraj' as the Congress objective and authorized the Working Committee to launch a Civil Disobedience Movement, leading to the Dandi March in April 1930.

questions.text: As per Article 279A of the Constitution (inserted by the 101st Amendment Act, 2016), who acts as the ex-officio Chairperson of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council?

options.label: B
options.text: Chairman, Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)

questions.solution: Shortcut: Constitutional Designation Logic. The GST Council is a federal body balancing Centre-States; the Chair must be a political executive representing the Centre's fiscal authority, not the administrative head (CBIC) or the Head of Government (PM) directly. Full Solution: Article 279A(3) explicitly designates the Union Finance Minister as the ex-officio Chairperson. The Vice-Chairperson is chosen from amongst the State Finance Ministers. The Union Minister of State for Finance is a member, not the Chair.

questions.text: Which of the following rivers of the Peninsular India flows westwards and forms an estuary?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate major East-flowing rivers forming deltas (Mahanadi, Godavari, Kaveri). The Narmada and Tapi are the only major west-flowing rivers forming estuaries. Full Solution: The Narmada River originates from Amarkantak and flows westwards through a rift valley between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges, draining into the Gulf of Khambhat forming an estuary, unlike the east-flowing rivers which form large deltas.

questions.text: Under Article 368, which of the following constitutional provisions requires a Special Majority of Parliament **and** ratification by the Legislatures of not less than one-half of the States for amendment?

options.label: D
options.text: Admission or establishment of new States

questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the 'Federal Provisions List' mnemonic (7 items: President election, Executive powers, Judiciary, Distribution of powers, State representation in Parliament, Article 368 itself). 'Admission of new States' (Art 2/3) requires only Simple Majority. FR/DPSP usually need only Special Majority. Full Solution: Article 368(2) mandates that amendments affecting the federal structure—specifically the election of the President (Art 54/55), extent of executive powers, Supreme Court/High Courts, distribution of legislative powers, State representation in Parliament, or Article 368 itself—require Special Majority plus State ratification.
